thread:
Mason: heads up — after the kernel swap last night we're seeing a p99 spike on long-convo traffic (~2.6x). Noticed this at ~03:40 UTC in prod cluster-3.
Anita (runtime): ack. Is this across models or a specific model/profile?
Mason: mostly the 7B chat profile (seq len ~1024 typical), but small-seq traffic looks fine. CPU and GPU util look normal.
Li: I grabbed a short perf trace and flamegraph. Main hotspot is `flash_attn_forward` + a suspicious number of page faults attributed to our paged-KV pager. Link: https://ops.internal/flame/1955551229
Anita (runtime): hmm — could be batching combining long prefixes + paged-KV eviction causing thrash. Continuous batcher is trying to maximize token budget so it groups a few long requests then kernel swap picks FlashAttention path, but page faults kill the net latency.
Mason: here's quick profiler snippet:
```
# perf top sample
flash_attn_forward         41.2%  
paged_kv_page_in           18.7%  
batch_scheduler_wait_ms    12.3%  
mem_cgroup_page_faults     9.6%   
```
Anita (runtime): propose a short canary: 1) force fallback for sequences >512 to hybrid kernel, 2) lower continuous batcher token_budget for that queue from 2048 -> 1024, 3) increase queue_timeout to 12ms to avoid over-coalescing.
Li: I can run a micro-canary on cluster-3-spot now. Also instrument paged-KV stats (page-ins/sec, eviction rate).
perf-bot: Canary deploy started: canary/1955551234 -> cluster-3-spot (mason@trigger). Status: in-progress. :rocket:
Kai: quick note — if we reduce token_budget we might lower throughput for tail but improves p99. Good compromise for now.
Mason: agree. Run the canary and dump per-request kernel decision logs, e.g.:
```
INFO kernel_router: chosen_kernel=flash_attn, seq_len=1024, batch_tokens=1800, paged_kv_pages_in=42
```
Anita (runtime): if canary confirms, next step is adaptive routing: prefer hybrid kernel when paged_kv_pages_in > threshold OR when seq_len distribution is heavy-tail. I'll draft a knob in `kernel_routing` to combine page-fault signals.
Li: canary results: p99 dropped from 2.6x -> 1.05x baseline after reducing token_budget + kernel pin for long seqs. Eviction rate went down 78%. Pushed logs to https://ops.internal/canary/1955551234/results
Mason: excellent. schedule a short follow-up postmortem and rollout plan. I'll own the rollout to dedicated clusters tomorrow.
Anita (runtime): created ticket INF-7231 with config experiment and perf numbers. Will add a regression test in the batcher e2e harness to simulate paged-KV thrash.
perf-bot: Canary deploy completed: success.
Mason: thanks all :thumbsup:
